sn35.52:1.1: The root sense of _upassaṭṭha_ (“contaminated”) is something that has been poured upon, or on which something has been let loose ([an5.192:8.2]()). Cf. Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 1.3.6: “They contaminated (_upāsṛjan_) those gods with evil”, the evil being “unfit” (_apratirūpaṁ_) sights, sounds, etc.
